cards.front: Solar System
cards.back: The Sun and everything that orbits around it.
cards.say: Solar System. The Sun and everything that orbits around it. The Earth is part of the Solar System.

cards.front: What is at the centre of the Solar System?
cards.back: The Sun.
cards.say: What is at the centre of the Solar System? The Sun.

cards.front: How many planets are in our Solar System?
cards.back: Eight.
cards.say: How many planets are in our Solar System? Eight.

cards.front: Name the planet closest to the Sun.
cards.back: Mercury.
cards.say: Name the planet closest to the Sun. Mercury.

cards.front: Which planet do we live on?
cards.back: Earth, the third planet from the Sun.
cards.say: Which planet do we live on? Earth, the third planet from the Sun.

cards.front: Which planet is the biggest?
cards.back: Jupiter.
cards.say: Which planet is the biggest? Jupiter.

cards.front: Which planet has famous rings?
cards.back: Saturn.
cards.say: Which planet has famous rings? Saturn.

cards.front: Which planet is known as the red planet?
cards.back: Mars.
cards.say: Which planet is known as the red planet? Mars.

cards.front: Which planet is hottest?
cards.back: Venus, because of its thick atmosphere.
cards.say: Which planet is hottest? Venus, because of its thick atmosphere.

cards.front: Which is the farthest planet from the Sun?
cards.back: Neptune.
cards.say: Which is the farthest planet from the Sun? Neptune.

cards.front: Which planets are rocky?
cards.back: Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars.
cards.say: Which planets are rocky? Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars.

cards.front: Which planets are gas giants?
cards.back: Jupiter and Saturn. Uranus and Neptune are ice giants.
cards.say: Which planets are gas giants? Jupiter and Saturn. Uranus and Neptune are ice giants.

cards.front: Name the planets in order from the Sun.
cards.back: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
cards.say: Name the planets in order from the Sun. Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.

cards.front: What is a moon?
cards.back: A natural object that orbits a planet.
cards.say: What is a moon? A natural object that orbits a planet.

cards.front: How many moons does the Earth have?
cards.back: One.
cards.say: How many moons does the Earth have? One.

cards.front: asteroid
cards.back: A rocky object that orbits the Sun. Most are in a belt between Mars and Jupiter.
cards.say: asteroid. A rocky object that orbits the Sun. Most are in a belt between Mars and Jupiter.

cards.front: comet
cards.back: An icy object that orbits the Sun and grows a tail when it comes near.
cards.say: comet. An icy object that orbits the Sun and grows a tail when it comes near.

cards.front: dwarf planet
cards.back: A small round object that orbits the Sun but is not a planet. Pluto is one.
cards.say: dwarf planet. A small round object that orbits the Sun but is not a planet. Pluto is one.

cards.front: Is the Sun a star?
cards.back: Yes. It is the star at the centre of the Solar System.
cards.say: Is the Sun a star? Yes. It is the star at the centre of the Solar System.

cards.front: Why is Earth a good place for life?
cards.back: It has liquid water, air and the right temperature.
cards.say: Why is Earth a good place for life? It has liquid water, air and the right temperature.

cards.front: Which is the nearest star to Earth?
cards.back: The Sun.
cards.say: Which is the nearest star to Earth? The Sun.

cards.front: Are planets bigger or smaller than the Sun?
cards.back: Smaller. The Sun is much bigger.
cards.say: Are planets bigger or smaller than the Sun? Smaller. The Sun is much bigger.

cards.front: True or false: All planets have life.
cards.back: False. As far as we know, only Earth does.
cards.say: True or false: All planets have life. False. As far as we know, only Earth does.
